title: Visually Grounded Reasoning across Languages and Cultures
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the accuracy of vision-language models on a binary true/false visual reasoning task. This included reasoning about images and textual descriptions related to cultural concepts, one category of which was 'Religion and belief', including objects, events, and celebrations (e.g., Kurban Bayramı/Eid al-Adha).
findings: Performance on the 'Religion and belief' concept category was evaluated as part of the broader benchmark. Model accuracy on this category varied significantly across languages and models, and was generally low (ranging from 54.2% to 71.7% in different settings, where 50% is chance), indicating difficulty in reasoning about culturally-specific religious concepts.
